verdict.rationale: Scoped credentials for agents are a fair question for an agent-building SDK, so the axis applies. The evidence only documents tool-permission modes, rules, the canUseTool callback, hooks, and per-subagent tool access. These are adjacent runtime controls on tool use, not a way to issue scoped or least-privilege API credentials, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
